question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Applause
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Applause"** means clapping hands to show approval or admiration. (तालियाँ)

 
 
• **Example:** The audience gave a loud **applause** after the performance.
 
 
 
• **"Taunt"** refers to a remark made in order to anger, wound, or provoke someone. (ताना)
 
 
• **Example:** He **taunted** his opponent during the match, trying to unsettle him.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Applause'** is **'Taunt'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Praise **(प्रशंसा): The expression of approval or admiration for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She received **praise** for her outstanding performance.
 
 
 
• **Intolerant **(असहिष्णु): Not willing to accept views, beliefs, or behavior that differ from one's own.
 
 
• **Example:** He is **intolerant** of any criticism.
 
 
 
• **Pray** (प्रार्थना): Address a solemn request or expression of thanks to a deity or other object of worship.
 
 
• **Example:** They** pray** every morning before breakfast.
